newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: INSIGHT-Australian All Ordinaries overbought, may retrace.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-Australian All Ordinaries overbought, may retrace.

text.p: ---------------Analysis by Daniel Fock - Aug 4--------------
*Index resistance at 2,750
*Possibility of pivot point reversal
*Leading indicators overbought
The Australian All Ordinaries index (Fri: 2,727.5, down 7.6) is higher than last week and while above 2,715, traders are likely to remain bullish.
Leading indicators are overbought, so the chances of a retracement are growing.
The 2,715 level was important on the way up and now traders are likely to cover longs if price falls below.
Short term technicals are bullish and becoming overbought.

Averages are all bullish. Leading indicators have or are starting to move lower. While these are falling and price is below 2,750, traders will be focussing on lower Fibonacci retracements. These levels are 2,703, 2,689 and 2,676.
Medium term the index is higher but is still to break the recent high at 2,757.
The bull trend has some renewed energy so traders will be using bull strategies while the index is above 2,715.
The shorter term potential pivot point reversal is a concern, so traders are unlikely to add to positons until the index rises above 2,750.
Medium term technicals are bullish. Averages are bullish and leading indicators have turned higher again but are moving into overbought territory.

Traders will be comfortable holding longs while the index is above 2,715, but will still be cautious while indicators are overbought. If the current high remains unbroken, traders will focus on Fibonacci retracements of 2,598, 2,549 and 2,500.

In the longer term, the index is still bullish but while below June's high of 2,728, traders will be cautious and with leading indicators overbought, they will look for reasons to liquidate positions.
Longer term technicals are mixed and overbought.
Averages remain bullish. All leading indicators are overbought and moving lower, albeit slowly. Stochastics still very overbought and sidelined at 99/94.
The index is higher above 2,715. Leading indicators are overbought and while below June's high at 2,728, traders will be cautious.
Traders are likely to remain long unless 2,715 breaks. They will remain cautious, especially as the index came off the highs towards week's end.
Seasoned traders are also concerned about a potential pivot point reversal.
The index will have to trade above 2,742 for this to be extinguished.
Otherwise, traders are remaining cautiously bullish but are ready to take profits if indicators or price falls.
(Daniel Fock is a member of the Australian Technical Analysts Association. Views are his own, not Reuters.)
